headline_marked: Apple SVP Greg Joswiak: ‘[[We don’t feel threatened]]’ by OpenAI hardware plans
headline: Apple SVP Greg Joswiak: ‘We don’t feel threatened’ by OpenAI hardware plans
summary: Apple's SVP of Worldwide Marketing, Greg Joswiak, addressed concerns about OpenAI's potential hardware ventures, stating Apple's confidence in its position.
details: Greg "Joz" Joswiak, Apple's SVP of Worldwide Marketing, recently spoke about the company's stance on artificial intelligence and the competitive landscape.
During an interview, Joswiak specifically addressed questions regarding OpenAI's potential move into hardware, asserting that Apple does not perceive this as a threat.
His comments provide insight into Apple's internal perspective on the evolving AI market and its confidence in its own product strategy, even as other tech giants explore new hardware avenues.

headline_marked: [[iPhone Duo makes TIME's Best Inventions of 2026 list]], John Ternus discusses 'cheap' foldables
headline: iPhone Duo makes TIME's Best Inventions of 2026 list, John Ternus discusses 'cheap' foldables
summary: Apple's new foldable was recognized by TIME, with SVP John Ternus interviewed about its innovations and the broader foldable market. Pre-orders are opening soon.
details: Apple's innovative iPhone Duo has been officially named one of TIME's Best Inventions of 2026. This significant recognition highlights the device's impact on the tech landscape.

John Ternus, Apple's SVP of Hardware Engineering, was featured in the cover story interview. He reportedly discussed the iPhone Duo and made comments regarding "cheap and crappy" foldables in the market.
The iPhone Duo is noted for its "renewable" display layer, a feature that may help consumers justify its price point. This layer suggests a focus on sustainability or durability.
Enthusiasts can prepare for pre-orders, which are set to open tomorrow. Apple has also set a cutoff time for those looking to secure the fastest delivery of their new iPhone Duo.
caption:
The iPhone Duo has landed on TIME's Best Inventions of 2026 list! Apple's John Ternus weighed in on the device and the foldable market.

Apple's innovative iPhone Duo has been officially named one of TIME's Best Inventions of 2026. This significant recognition highlights the device's impact on the tech landscape.

John Ternus, Apple's SVP of Hardware Engineering, was featured in the cover story interview. He reportedly discussed the iPhone Duo and made comments regarding "cheap and crappy" foldables in the market.

The iPhone Duo is noted for its "renewable" display layer, a feature that may help consumers justify its price point. This layer suggests a focus on sustainability or durability.

Enthusiasts can prepare for pre-orders, which are set to open tomorrow. Apple has also set a cutoff time for those looking to secure the fastest delivery of their new iPhone Duo.
